title: Machine and Signal
author: Ines Delacroix
blurb: Juniper Crane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
